rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the joint solemn session of 31 August 2016 (opened 16:41, closed 16:52) Michel Temer took the constitutional oath and the President of the National Congress (Renan Calheiros) declared him 'empossado no cargo de Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil ... para o período de 31 de agosto de 2016 a 31 de dezembro de 2018'; the session was called to give him office 'para o período a iniciar-se nesta data, tendo em vista a vacância do cargo'.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed Termo de Posse states that at 16:00 on 31 August 2016, before the National Congress in joint session in the Senate chamber, Vice-President Michel Temer appeared to be invested under art. 79 of the Constitution in the office of President 'em virtude de vacância ocorrida em trinta e um de agosto de dois mil e dezesseis', and took the oath.

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: At the opening of the session, the Mesa included 'o Exmo Vice-Presidente da República, no exercício da Presidência', who was then called to take the oath as Michel Temer.
